name: guizang-material-illustration
title_zh: 把任何文字内容转成贵藏风格图解插画
tagline_zh: 文章、笔记、汇报、教程、科普……丢进来就出带字配图。不用会画，不用找素材，数据也能变3D图表。
tagline_en: Drop in articles, notes, reports, tutorials, or science topics—get labeled illustrations and 3D data charts. No.
desc_en: Generate Guizang-style material illustrations, labeled explanatory visuals, material-styled chart illustrations, and data-first editorial images from articles, notes, product concepts, workplace reports, creator posts, tutorials, school materials, humanities topics, science explanations, screenshots, or chart data. Use when the user asks for 配图, 带字插图, 解释图, 图解插画, 概念拆解图, 图表美化, 数据图美化, 3D 图表, 汇报配图, 内容
why_zh: 它不套模板，而是先拆解内容结构，再按贵藏风格的标注逻辑重排信息层级，让图自带解释力，而非装饰。
why_en: It doesn't apply templates—it parses content structure, then rebuilds information hierarchy with Guizang-style annotations.
limit_zh: 只吃文字输入，不吃图片改绘；输出为单张静态图，不产出多页文档或动图；对超长报告只截取核心段落，超出部分不保证完整覆盖。
limit_en: Text-only input, no image redraws; outputs single static images, not multi-page docs or GIFs; long reports get core excerpts only, full coverage not.
